l-e-e3-b05-12.material: I like cats. I like dogs. → I like cats and dogs. / We play ball. We play cards. → We play ball and cards. Wara règle na sara I read books. I read comics. na mbeni phrase oko.
l-e-e3-b05-12.s.s1.r.b: A sara mbeni tënë na and pëpe. Ni ayeke tî règle ni pëpe.
l-e-e3-b05-12.s.s1.r.d: Place tî and ayeke sio. And ayeke na ndö ti yanga use ni.
l-e-e3-b05-12.s.s1.explain: Tene ye ni so ayeke tâ mbeni ye oko oko, na sara ti and na ndö ti yanga use so ayeke ndoye. I read books and comics. ayeke nzoni.
l-e-e3-b05-12.s.s2.model.0: Na ndö ti ye kue, a tene ye ni so ayeke tâ mbeni oko oko, na and ayeke na ndö ti yanga use so ayeke ndoye, so ni ayeke I read books and comics.
l-e-e3-b05-12.s.s2.model.1: I read ayeke na ndö ti tënë pëpe lâ use, na books na comics asara ti and, so tënë so ayeke tî règle ni.

l-e-e3-b05-13.goal: Na ndö ti ye mingi ti règle so e mû e na terê ti tënë ti son ti voyelle, wara na tene règle ni, na hon ti règle ni na mbeni ye ti vurü.

l-e-e3-b05-13.s.s1.r.c: Ni ayeke paire so a mû e na terê pëpe. Voyelle ni asara changement.

l-e-e3-b05-13.s.s2.model.1: Mbeni ni ayeke paire so a sara changement ti lettre, a mû e na terê pëpe, so mat - mate ayeke nzoni.

l-e-e3-b03-19.material: Mbi lingbi tî sû approximativement anzo anglais 5 na minute 1. Mbi aye tî sû anzo 24 na journal tî mbi. Estimer ni abezoin approximativement minutes mingi tongana nyen.
l-e-e3-b03-19.s.s1.r.a: Na minute 1 mo lingbi tî sû gï anzo 5.
l-e-e3-b03-19.s.s1.r.d: Ni asara kua na nömörö tî anzo tongana minutes tongana ni ayeke.
l-e-e3-b03-19.s.s1.explain: 24 ayeke vuko na 25. Na anzo 5 na minute 1, anzo 25 abezoin minutes 5, ndali ni ayeke approximativement minutes 5.
l-e-e3-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: Tongana a bâ 24 tongana 25, na anzo 5 na minute 1 ni ayeke minutes 5, ndali ni ayeke approximativement minutes 5.
l-e-e3-b03-19.s.s2.model.1: Mo sû anzo 5 na minute 1, ndali ni anzo 24 abezoin vuko na minutes 5.

l-e-e3-b01-33.material: Mo ahinga aformes ti passé ti play, walk, go, see. A: Zia -ed na averbes kue. B: Hinga lisoro averbes so a zia -ed na ala na averbes so achange forme, tongana go na see.

l-e-e3-b01-33.s.s1.o.d: Oko ape a ye ti ti hinga

l-e-e3-b01-33.s.s1.explain: Verbe so afason ti ala andoye tongana go-went na see-saw alingbi ti a hunda na tele ti ala.

l-e-e3-b01-33.s.s2.model.1: B asara na règle ti -ed na exception use, ni la fason ti passé sioni akiri kete.

l-e-e3-b05-31.material: I get up at seven. I eat lunch at noon. I go to bed at nine. Mo yeke tri routine ti lâ na lâ. A: Gbu na ordre ti ntangu so ayeke kozo. B: Gbu na ordre ti phrase so ayeke kete mingi.

l-e-e3-b05-31.s.s1.o.c: B: Phrase kete ayeke ngangu pëpe ti hunda
